title: 第1章 流氓第2章 天命难改我来改
content_zh:
大玄王朝，元狩三年春。
河水溢于平原，大饥，人相食。
落日的余辉洒在武陵城的长街之上，苏牧将背上的担子放在几个汉子面前，几乎弯成九十度的腰总算直了起来。
“苏牧，你今天一共砍了八十七斤柴，我算你九十斤，合计九文钱。”
为首的汉子让人称了一下苏牧放下的担子，往手指上吐了口唾沫，将账本掀了几页，扫了一眼说道。
“多谢张爷照顾。”
苏牧赔起一张笑脸。
那张爷数了几个铜钱，随手抛在了地上，发出叮叮当当的清脆声响。
苏牧赶忙蹲下，快速地将散落一地的铜钱捡了起来。
七个铜钱。
数量没错。
出城三趟，砍回来八十七斤柴，再扣掉两文钱的例钱，剩下七文钱。
…………
“这什么破地方破地方破地方！
活着怎么这么难！”
苏牧走在泥泞的街道上，胸中的戾气不断冲撞。
已经过了两个月了，苏牧到现在都想不明白，他一个拥有光明前途的双一流高校毕业生，怎么就一觉醒来就出现在了这武陵城中呢？
而且还是个彻头彻尾的流氓！
无房无地为流，没有正当职业曰氓。
“唉，我比流氓还差一点，人家流氓至少还有户籍，我现在是连户籍都没有啊。”

苏牧穿过泥泞的巷子，钻进一间四面透风的破庙之内。
数月前，前身的家乡遭了大水，前身一路流亡到了武陵城，最后饥病交加着死去，被现在的苏牧占据了身体。
为了安顿流民，朝廷特意网开一面，允许流民在武陵入籍，条件是，一个户籍五百文。
武陵城是方圆数百里内数一数二的大城，放在平时，一个武陵城的户籍至少也得值几十两银子。
五百文，已经是朝廷对流民的优待。
但就算如此——
“还差三百五十文……”
苏牧忍不住叹了口气，“该死的柴帮，城里的柴火三文钱十斤，卖给他们却只是一文钱十斤，就这样，他们还要抽例钱，无量资本家都没他们这么狠！”
他现在这具身体严重营养不良，根本就没什么力气，一天能背七八十斤柴火已经是极限，到手七八文钱，再刨除每日吃饭的两三文，每日最多也只能攒下四五文钱而已。
要是碰上下雨的天气，那么就连这四五文钱都没有。
刚刚醒来的时候，苏牧也想凭借自身超前的知识来过上丰衣足食的美好日子。
结果还没等他大展拳脚，他就发现这个世界没有他想的那么简单。
自从亲眼看到一个人一拳就将一块一人多高的石头打穿以后，他就知道这是一个拥有超凡力量的世界，普通人根本就难以出头。
况且，就算当个普通人也没有那么容易。
在武陵城中，不是他想做什么就能做的。
各行各业，都被某一势力给垄断了。
想有个正当的职业，首先得有户籍才成。
content_en:
In the Daxuan Dynasty, in the spring of the third year of Yuanshou.
The rivers overflowed the plains, there was a great famine, and people ate each other.
The afterglow of the setting sun shone on the long street of Wuling City. Su Mu placed the burden on his back in front of several men, and his waist, which was almost bent at ninety degrees, finally straightened up.
"Su Mu, you chopped a total of eighty-seven kilograms of firewood today. I'll count your ninety kilograms, totaling nine cents."
The leading man asked someone to weigh the burden that Su Mu had put down, spit on his finger, opened a few pages of the account book, glanced at it and said.
"Thank you, Mr. Zhang, for taking care of me."
Su Mu put on a smile.
Mr. Zhang counted a few copper coins and threw them on the ground, making a ringing sound.
Su Mu hurriedly squatted down and quickly picked up the copper coins scattered on the ground.
Seven copper coins.
The quantity is correct.
After three trips out of the city, he chopped down eighty-seven kilograms of firewood. After deducting two cents of regular money, he was left with seven cents.
…………
“This is a broken place, a broken place, a broken place!
Why is it so difficult to live! "
Su Mu walked on the muddy street, the anger in his chest kept colliding.
Two months have passed, and Su Mu still can't figure out why he, a double-first-class college graduate with a bright future, appeared in Wuling City as soon as he woke up?
And he's a complete gangster!
Those who have no house, no land, and no legitimate occupation are called hooligans.
"Oh, I'm a little worse than a gangster. At least other gangsters have household registration. I don't even have household registration now."
Su Mu walked through the muddy alley and got into a dilapidated temple with drafts on all sides.
A few months ago, my predecessor's hometown was hit by a flood, and he fled all the way to Wuling City. In the end, he died of hunger and disease, and his body was taken over by the current Su Mu.
In order to settle the refugees, the imperial court deliberately allowed the refugees to naturalize in Wuling, on the condition that each household registration required 500 Wen.
Wuling City is one of the largest cities within hundreds of miles. In normal times, a household registration in Wuling City would be worth at least dozens of taels of silver.
Five hundred coins was already the imperial court's preferential treatment for the refugees.
But even so——
"There are still three hundred and fifty coins left..."
Su Mu couldn't help but sigh, "Damn the firewood gang, the firewood in the city costs three cents and ten catties, but the firewood sold to them is only one penny and ten catties. Just like this, they still have to collect money, and the infinite capitalists are not as ruthless as them!"
His current body is severely malnourished and he has no strength at all. He can carry seven or eighty kilograms of firewood a day which is his limit. With seven or eight pennies in hand, excluding the two or three pennies for daily meals, he can only save four or five pennies at most every day.
If it rains, you won't even have the four or five cents.
When he just woke up, Su Mu also wanted to rely on his advanced knowledge to live a good life with plenty of food and clothing.
As a result, before he could show his talents, he discovered that the world was not as simple as he thought.
Ever since he saw a man punch through a stone as tall as a person with one punch, he knew that this was a world with extraordinary power, and it was difficult for ordinary people to get ahead.
Besides, even being an ordinary person is not that easy.
In Wuling City, he can't do whatever he wants.
All walks of life are monopolized by a certain force.
If you want to have a legitimate career, you must first have a household registration.
